[Sonnet check 2026-10-21: every PCSK9 agent needs PA (Repatha PA+QL p.128; Praluent PA+SP+QL p.128; Leqvio PA p.220). The PDL shows no lower barrier for Leqvio (QL is not a PA-level barrier), so preferredAgent changed from Leqvio to Repatha, the most commonly prescribed; Leqvio moved to paRequired.]
